run_pybullet_graphics_client: run a pybullet graphics client that connects via TCP and simulates a scene with URDF models
connect_graphics_server: connect to a pybullet graphics server using GRAPHICS_SERVER_TCP mode
load_urdf_models: load URDF files like plane.urdf and r2d2.urdf into the pybullet simulation
configure_gravity: set gravity parameters and add a user debug slider to adjust gravity at runtime
step_simulation_loop: run a continuous simulation loop that steps physics while the client remains connected
